wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 09-008 wires the player-damage / armor path via one src/vanilla facade (wirePlayerDamage.ts) re-exporting the read-only implement-player-damage-and-armor (applyVanillaPlayerDamage + VANILLA_ARMOR_TYPE_NONE/GREEN/BLUE + VANILLA_SKILL_BABY) and a focused set of ai/attacks damage-source constants (VILE_ATTACK_DAMAGE 20, VILE_RADIUS_ATTACK_DAMAGE 70, MELEERANGE, MISSILERANGE, MAX_SKULLS_PER_LEVEL). VANILLA_PLAYER_DAMAGE_INVARIANTS pins five rules (green floor(d/3) / blue floor(d/2) absorption; baby-skill halving; depleted armor resets type to none; god mode nullifies; health floors at 0). The focused test exercises applyVanillaPlayerDamage across the god/baby/green/blue/deplete/death cases, the constants, the frozen manifest, the ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. This step is the other side of the 09-008<->10-002 cycle fixed at cb296d9. No const enums re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax).
